# Saper Vedere

Saper Vedere is an interactive Atlas and Codex of Leonardo da Vinci's works,
methods, and cross-disciplinary ideas.

## Primary sections

- [Atlas of Causes](./#atlas) - Light, Flow, Force, and Measure
- [Paintings](./#opere) - paintings and close-looking annotations
- [Notebook folios](./#fogli) - facsimile sheets and commentary
- [Machine studies](./#macchine) - interpretive machine animations
- [Painting-space studies](./#dipinti) - interpretive spatial experiences
- [Mirror fieldbook](./#specchio) - mirror-writing interaction
- [Sources and rights](./#colophon) - sources, rights, and declared departures

Artwork credits and licenses are presented beside individual artifacts.
